name: OpenAI Gemini Llama Example
summary: Demonstrates building an AI agent using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) with open LLMs like Meta Llama 3, OpenAI, or Google Gemini, and a SQLite database.

name: Self Learning
summary: Autonomous skill generator that learns new technologies from the web. Use when, users want to learn about a new library/framework/tool, need to create a skill for an unfamiliar technology, want to research and document a technology's usage patterns, or invoke with `/learn <topic>`. This skill uses web search and browser tools to discover, extract, and synthesize documentation into a reusable skill.
